clips.title: The story
paras: Young tauren begin their training at Camp Narache, high on Red Cloud Mesa in southern Mulgore. The camp is the Hawkwind tribe’s ancestral home, where elders preserve old ways as quilboar press close and centaur scouts linger.

Camp Narache sits at the northern edge of Red Cloud Mesa, the main settlement of the Hawkwind tribe. Hide lodges and pavilions house the wounded, store weapons, bake bread, and offer a place for meditation and communion with ancestors. At the camp’s heart, elders and path trainers gather in a circle. Greatmother Hawkwind guides the newly initiated as they take up their roles as defenders of the Earth Mother.

Steep cliffs shield Camp Narache, but threats reach the mesa all the same. Bristleback quilboar from Brambleblade Ravine press into Hawkwind lands, while centaur scouts remain in the distance. Young hunters, shamans, druids, and warriors prove their mettle by thinning aggressive wildlife, guarding the village well, and driving back quilboar raiders. Then they descend the grand path into Mulgore’s wider valleys.
